# Plain-text content controls

Original OOXML fixture generated by `tools/plain_text_controls_fixture.py`.
Twelve cases cover temporary and persistent inline controls, partial and caret
formatting, temporary controls around one paragraph, text entry, soft breaks,
and preservation of an existing break with `multiLine="0"`.

The reference application produced `native.pdf` and the retained `*-native.xml`
edit results. `tools/plain_text_controls_native.ps1` reproduces the native edits;
`tools/plain_text_controls_reference.py` extracts the reference text, formatting,
wrapper counts and hashes. Intermediate native DOCX packages are scratch outputs,
not product fixtures. No corpus content is included.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.5.2.44 says formatting applied to any part affects the whole
plain-text control. The reference application also does this for an interior caret. Partial/caret bold
preserves temporary wrappers; text changes remove them (§17.5.2.43). Persistent
inline wrappers survive text changes. The app retains the user's selection while
expanding the effective formatting range for direct formatting, clear formatting,
and character styles.

`placeholders.docx` is a separate original control with gray prompt text and blue
input properties. Its `*-selection2-*-native.xml` references use the reference application's selection
formatting/typing commands: bold changes the prompt appearance, while entered
text still uses the blue, nonbold input properties. Formatting actual values
updates the wrapper's input properties as well as its visible runs. Both paths
are checked through export and exact undo; they must not be conflated.

Native divergence: §17.5.2.44 says `multiLine` affects new soft-break insertion,
not existing breaks. The reference application's `Selection.TypeText` and `Range.Text` nevertheless
insert U+000B and save `w:br` even with false/omitted `multiLine`. The app follows
that observed text-entry behavior and preserves the declaration. In contrast,
the reference application's `Range.InsertBreak(6)` rejected the operation even in the multiline control;
that automation command is not the reference for text entry. Native results in
this fixture use `Selection.TypeText` for soft breaks. This does not authorize
multiple paragraphs inside persistent inline controls.

Supported import is limited to uniformly formatted plain-text runs, temporary
controls enclosing one paragraph/cell, and persistent inline controls. Persistent
block wrappers, mixed formatting, nested controls and non-text contents remain
rejected by strict import. Pictures and hyperlinks cannot be inserted into a
persistent plain-text control. Existing rich-text controls retain their partial
formatting behavior.
